title: Observer design for Lur'e-type systems via injection of a reconstructed nonlinear output
summary: Observer design for Lur'e-type systems typically reduces to solving a linear matrix inequality (LMI). In certain cases, the observer gain may grow unbounded with the coupling strength. We propose reconstructing key nonlinear terms via a bank of second-order sliding-mode observers and injecting them into a Luenberger observer as additional measurements. This feeds a second correction channel that attenuates the nonlinear coupling in the error dynamics.
